summary: More hrobot storagebox deprecations: plans[].month in the snapshot plan modules (always null now), password_mode=set-to-random in storagebox_subaccount (legacy API only, removed in 3.0.0), and several subaccount return values renamed under the new API.
questions: Can I still set a random password on a Hetzner storagebox subaccount?
Why is plans[].month always null in storagebox_snapshot_plan?
Which storagebox_subaccount return values are deprecated?

answer_card.title: storagebox subaccount and snapshot plan deprecations
answer_card.answer_md:
- `storagebox_subaccount`: `password_mode=set-to-random` is deprecated (legacy API only) and will be removed in 3.0.0.
- `storagebox_snapshot_plan` / `_info`: `plans[].month` is deprecated because it's always `null` in the new API.
- Subaccount return values like `homedirectory`, `samba`, `ssh`, `webdav`, `readonly`, `createtime` and `comment` are deprecated. See the docs for the new names.
